So, Rise has just dropped on PC today, and I'd say I enjoyed the 2013 reboot enough that I'm considering picking it up, given that I've got a code from GMG to knock some of the price off, and my time with MGSV is about to come to an end. I enjoy going into most games somewhat 'blind' - I'm a fan of surprises - but having got the reboot for dirt cheap during the Steam Winter Sale, I didn't want to pay 10x the price for Rise and feel slightly disappointed, so I've checked out some of the promo material and videos to see what I'd be in for, and it all looks rather fun. Given that it's been out for the past few months for the Xbox One, some of you may also have already finished with it, and as such I'd love your expertise. Thoughts on Rise of the Tomb Raider?

I don't have an Xbox one so I bought the 360 version. It pays as well as the 2013 game, looks lovely despite the old hardware although the one and PC version will look better but it didn't detract from the game. I played through the whole thing in a few days which is a sign I'm enjoying a game. Highly recommended and I especially enjoyed getting the "was that really necessary?" achievement.

Ah, I wasn't aware it released on the 360 (I had a PS3 but built my PC about 6/7 months ago so I've zoned out from consoles mostly since then). As just a rough guess, how many hours would you say you put into it? SOme promo I read from the devs suggested at least 20 hours if you were to go solely for the story, with about 30 if you wanted to see all there is (pinch of salt as they're obviously they're trying to sell their game), but HLTB has ROTTR averaging between 12-17 hours.

There are side missions so the total can vary. The main game is probably 10-12 hours and I guess I've done a bit more than that as I've tended to do a bit of tomb hunting too. I like the puzzles and of course, there are areas you can't get to on first pass but you can fast travel back once you've got the necessary upgrades. It is a style of game I like, rather like uncharted in fact which will be my next purchase for the PS4 having recently run through the remasters. I have a PS3 so played them on there along with Tomb Raider. Hadn't thought I would buy any more games for the 360 but I'm glad the last one I'll likely buy is RotTR because it is such a good title and fully uses the 360 without looking hacked to death like BLOPSIII did (which I got on PS4 because I'm all about the campaign and never play online)
